depth_justification: The first two turns are genuinely laser-specific to MediCall with correct precise citations (France PHC Art. L4131-1, télémédecine R6316-1, confidentiality L1110-4, 20-year retention to a minor's 28th birthday; Swiss MedPA/nFADP; GDPR Art. 9(2)(a)/(h) for the listed data types), but the model then loops the identical P1.D2/D3/D4 block verbatim across five consecutive turns, capping real progression.
